newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai plans to set up large enterprise group.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai plans to set up large enterprise group.

text.p: Shanghai, the hub of China's burgeoning economy, plans to establish several giant enterprises that will be listed among the world's 500 top firms by the year 2000, the official Xinhua news agency said.
Two or three "super large" enterprises will be set up in the city, each with annual sales of 100 billion yuan, it said.
Shanghai also planned to set up 15 large enterprises, each with five billion yuan of annual sales, and 10 with 10 billion yuan of annual sales to rank among China's top 100 firms, Xinhua said.
The city's chemical, medical, machinery and electrical enterprises were among the most successful in China, it said.
Shanghai already has 110 corporations with annual sales of more than 500 million yuan each, accounting for 65.8 percent of the city's industrial sector, it said.
